scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run test && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project birdsmyboss-v1-dev --only firestore "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
scripts.test:callable-smoke: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project birdsmyboss-v1-dev --only auth,firestore,functions "npm --prefix functions run test:callable-smoke"
scripts.test:phase6: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project birdsmyboss-v1-dev --only auth,firestore,functions "npm --prefix functions run test:phase6"
scripts.test:emulator:all: firebase emulators:exec --project birdsmyboss-v1-dev --only auth,firestore,storage "npm --prefix functions run test:integration:all"
scripts.validate:firebase: firebase use birdsmyboss-v1-dev && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions "npm run typecheck && npm run test"
